title: I'm developing a single-player RPG about humans vs orcs, inspired by Warcraft, Skyrim, and Oblivion. Below is the trailer for the Orc campaign.
author: Glass_Definition_583
selftext:
AI in my workflow: the background music for this trailer was generated using Suno. I went through several iterations tweaking the style prompt (orchestral, tribal percussion, war chant choir) to get a tone that matched the "clans uniting for war" feeling I wanted for the Orc campaign specifically. It's been a much faster way to prototype mood/tone for different scenes than trying to license or compose something from scratch at this stage. Curious if others here are using AI for music/audio specifically - has it been reliable enough for you to use in a final release, or mostly for prototyping/temp tracks? Wishlist here if you want to follow the project: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4877870/Elyndor\_Quest/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4877870/Elyndor_Quest/)   
  
Note: I'm currently recording the Human campaign trailer.
